follow-up time: Variable, up to 420 days after laparoscopic tubal reanastomosis
cohort: 27 women who underwent laparoscopic tubal reanastomosis after bilateral tubal ligation
finding: Laparoscopic tubal reanastomosis resulted in a satisfactory pregnancy rate (55.5%) in selected patients who desired reversal of tubal sterilization.
mod_finding: Tubal sterilization was performed via Pomeroy's technique during a cesarean section in all patients.
